# Source-of-Truth and Package-Boundary Matrix

<!-- @generated by `node scripts/conformance/run.mjs --write` from contracts/authority/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Matrix revision 1 (`DR-0002@1`), additive. The decision record [`DR-0002`](decisions/DR-0002-authority-matrix.json) is draft, so no row is citable yet. [`contracts/authority/matrix.json`](../contracts/authority/matrix.json) gives every durable concept and relation one command owner, one target authority, its read projections, a privacy floor or visibility, a package, a disposition, and a transfer. Code citations are lines at `62d4eae`; spec lines are in rounds-review `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-18-rounds-review-board-design.md`.

## Using It

- Before you write a store, find its row here or in [`baseline-stores.json`](../contracts/authority/baseline-stores.json), and write only through that row's command owner. Cite the row in your leaf's `consumes` as `DR-0002@<revision>:<row-id>`, for example `DR-0002@1:appearance`.
- A cell holds a value, `pending:<leaf-id>` (that leaf fills it; the row is citable and stays closed to implementation until then), `n/a:<reason>`, or `blocked:OD-<n>` (an open owner decision; the row is not citable, and the cell holds only its row).
- A row has one writable authority at any revision: its legacy writer until the transfer leaf switches it, then the target. Compatibility adapters read, shadow, or compare, never write (spec 2641-2644). Browser storage holds only account-namespaced preferences, drafts, and caches that yield to the server (spec 2005-2007).
- To change a row, edit `matrix.json`, give the row the new matrix revision and its `compatibility`, raise `revision` in the matrix and in DR-0002, regenerate, and get the record re-approved (its `approvalRef` pins the SHA-256 of `matrix.json`, `packages.json`, and `owner-labels.json`). Changing a row's command owner, target authority, privacy floor or visibility, scope, or package is breaking, and only that row's citers re-cite. Filling a pending cell or adding a row is additive. Rows are superseded, never deleted.
- #155 (ROUNDS-32-L01) maps every store, field, and key to a row, and #18 (ROUNDS-02-L01) assigns each row its storage. #72 (ROUNDS-14-L01) owns privacy classes, sink policy, and the field map, which only tightens a floor; loosening one needs a breaking revision.
- Check with `node scripts/conformance/run.mjs` and `node --test scripts/conformance` (Node 22, no install). `--review <rounds-review>` also checks the spec rows verbatim, the ledger pin, and the owner labels against the catalog. `--write` regenerates this file and `baseline-stores.json`, keeping each store's rows and note.

## Checks

| Rule | Fails when | Codes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | A row names more than one target authority. | `AUTH_TWO_AUTHORITIES` |
| 2 | A store has writers in more than one module, or a derived consumer writes it, and no conflict with a disposition and resolving leaf names the row. | `AUTH_UNFLAGGED_WRITERS` |
| 3 | A relation has no owning row. | `AUTH_RELATION_UNOWNED` |
| 4 | A Secret row has a consumer other than a verifier or gateway. | `AUTH_SECRET_CONSUMER` |
| 5 | A row has no disposition, or one that is neither a ledger row nor new-platform-concept:INT-02 or INT-03. | `AUTH_NO_DISPOSITION` |
| 6 | A row names browser storage as its target authority. | `AUTH_BROWSER_AUTHORITY` |
| 7 | A cell is empty, or a leaf ID is not in leaf-ids.json. | `AUTH_EMPTY_CELL`, `AUTH_UNRESOLVED_REF` |
| 8 | A package, service, or term does not resolve. | `AUTH_UNRESOLVED_REF`, `AUTH_PACKAGE_MISMATCH` |
| 9 | A baseline-stores.json entry has no row, or a writer names an undeclared store. | `AUTH_STORE_NO_ROW`, `AUTH_STORE_UNDECLARED` |
| 10 | A Test Definition or Harness Revision row is not server-only. | `AUTH_CONTAINMENT_VISIBILITY` |
| 11 | A changed row keeps its revision or misdeclares its compatibility, or a row is removed. | `AUTH_REVISION_NOT_BUMPED`, `AUTH_COMPATIBILITY_UNDECLARED`, `AUTH_ROW_REMOVED` |
| 12 | A command type sits on two rows, or a row lists commands with no command owner. | `AUTH_COMMAND_DUPLICATE`, `AUTH_COMMAND_UNOWNED` |
| Coverage | A collection or browser key family at the audited revision has no baseline-stores.json entry, an entry is not a store there, or a storage call cannot be resolved. | `AUTH_STORE_UNDECLARED`, `AUTH_STORE_STALE` |
| Conflicts | One of #16's C1 to C13 is not flagged, or a row and a conflict disagree. | `AUTH_CONFLICT_MISSING`, `AUTH_CONFLICT_UNFLAGGED` |
| Projections | A spec read model has no row, two read models share a projector, or a projection's sources and consumers disagree. | `AUTH_READ_MODEL_MISSING`, `AUTH_PROJECTION_INCOMPLETE` |
| Migration | A row with baseline writers has no transfer block. | `AUTH_TRANSFER_MISSING` |
| Privacy | An account row has no privacy floor, a platform or pack row has no visibility, or a row lists no public-share entry. | `AUTH_PRIVACY_MISSING`, `AUTH_PUBLIC_SHARE_UNDECLARED` |
| Citations | A citation does not resolve at the audited revision, cites a credential line, or a DR-0002@<n>:<row> example names a missing row or revision. | `AUTH_CITATION_STALE`, `AUTH_CITES_SECRET`, `AUTH_CITATION_UNRESOLVED` |
| Secrets | An authority file holds a credential value or a secret-shaped string. | `AUTH_SECRET_VALUE` |
| Decisions | DR-0002 lacks one of OD-1 to OD-5, or a cell stays blocked on a decision that is no longer open. | `AUTH_OD_MISSING`, `AUTH_OD_SETTLED_BLOCKED` |
| Labels | A row's command owner disagrees with its capability's owner label, or (with --review) a label is not the catalog owner. | `AUTH_OWNER_LABEL_MISMATCH`, `AUTH_LABELS_PIN` |
| Corrections | An owner-sentence correction names the wrong rows, label, or owner. | `AUTH_CORRECTION_INVALID` |
| Pins | DR-0002 and the matrix disagree on revision, a ratified DR-0002 leaves a governed file unpinned, or (with --review) the spec rows or ledger differ from rounds-review. | `AUTH_REVISION_MISMATCH`, `AUTH_APPROVAL_INCOMPLETE`, `AUTH_SPEC_ROW_CHANGED`, `AUTH_LEDGER_PIN` |
